calculation.method: Seven equal preflight checks: pass=1, warning=0.5, blocker/not-run=0; round 100 times earned points divided by 7.
calculation.note: This measures smoke-test workflow readiness. It does not measure asset completeness and never overrides a blocker or owner gate.

checks.evidence: Private intake and public pilot JSON parsed; npm run verify-pilots inspected 7 pilot manifests, 63 asset slots, 15 private preview adapters, 2 regional manifests and 9 regional nodes.
Read-only enumeration found 17 Beethoven-labeled files under the Notion Intake root. SHA-256 was calculated for every file without moving or modifying a source master.

Identity, 24-route count, UIAA grade range, sport discipline and canonical crag ID come from database/api/v1/crags/helenental/beethovenwand.json and remain imported-unverified. No Notion/Google coordinates or model-derived geometry were promoted.

The 566,824,908-byte glTF 2.0 source has matching declared/actual length but references an external 86,346,775-byte texture. Ownership and derivative permission are unresolved, no web model exists, and Beethoven-specific hero/topo/panorama/scrub media is absent. Three Nasenwand videos play through explicit replaceable preview adapters while the release asset slots remain status=missing and src=null; they receive no Beethovenwand readiness credit.
Locator, Panorama, Routes, Wall and Topo + 3D remain the five permanent modules; Region to Rock to Sector to Topo remains a three-chapter journey; missing slots fail closed.

The local production preview rendered the regional map, proxy labels, permanent five-box journey and missing-asset fallbacks without runtime warnings/errors. The browser viewport override did not yield conclusive phone dimensions in this session; physical phone/tablet touch, drag and reduced-motion checks remain pending.

The production build generated the Serwist service worker and all proxy media was served from same-origin local paths. Offline, cache-clear and weak-signal behavior were not rerun in this session and remain release-checklist items.

preview.server: Local production build on port 3001. No public deployment was performed.

blockers: The named owner and usage rights for the GLB, external diffuse texture and related reconstruction files are not recorded.
Derivative creation, optimization, conversion and public/private-PWA copying are not authorized for the Beethovenwand model sources.
No web-ready Beethovenwand model, hero, topo, panorama or Beethovenwand-provenance scroll scrub exists.

Helenental and Däumling footage identity is owner-reported, not visually verified; exact source path, SHA-256, owner, permissions, timecodes, crops and posters remain pending where unresolved.
warnings: Notion correctly names the GLB but should be backfilled with the 16 additional exact Beethoven-labeled paths and hashes from this report.
Private preview adapters intentionally do not count as ready assets. Their release slots remain status=missing and src=null until approved media is supplied.
